nodes.label: App Shell (MainLayout: topbar + sidebar)
nodes.rationale: Pages never render their own navigation.

nodes.label: Per-User Theme Switching (chooseTheme, forceTheme, PUT /me/theme)
nodes.rationale: Theme saved on the user profile so it follows them across devices; login is always dark; main.jsx applies last theme before first render to avoid flash.

nodes.label: Form Handling Standard (React Hook Form + Zod)
nodes.norm_label: form handling standard (react hook form + zod)
nodes.rationale: All validation lives in a Zod schema in <page>Form.js with INITIAL_VALUES; no manual error/touched/loading state, no LABELS constant; conditional rules via superRefine.

nodes.label: Styling Standards (Bootstrap First, SCSS, No Tailwind)
nodes.norm_label: styling standards (bootstrap first, scss, no tailwind)
nodes.rationale: Leverage Bootstrap utilities; SCSS only for tokens/custom components; never Tailwind or inline styles.

nodes.label: Table Design Standard (Sortable Table Pattern)
nodes.rationale: All list tables share one pattern (ts-table-panel, SortableHead, useTableSort, newestFirst, TablePagination) for consistency; newest-first so new rows appear at the top.

nodes.label: Masters Org-Customer Pattern (OrgCustomerField, customerLabel)
nodes.rationale: Superadmin sees every customer's rows and picks the customer on the form (sent as userId); other users always work on their own company. Role/company come from the session; server enforces rules, UI only hides.

nodes.label: HttpOnly Session Cookie Authentication (AuthProvider, useAuth, ProtectedRoute)
nodes.norm_label: httponly session cookie authentication (authprovider, useauth, protectedroute)
nodes.rationale: Server sets HttpOnly cookie so no token is stored in the browser; GET /auth/me restores session; any 401 signs out.

nodes.label: Vite /api Proxy to Go API (API_PROXY_TARGET)
nodes.rationale: The Go server sends no CORS headers, so dev requests are proxied through Vite.

nodes.label: Full Page Width Layout Rule
nodes.rationale: Containers fill the screen with small gutters; wide screens get more grid columns instead of empty margins.

nodes.label: Light Theme as Second SCSS Build (_tokens-light, theme-light.scss)
nodes.norm_label: light theme as second scss build (_tokens-light, theme-light.scss)
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap bakes colours into SVG icons and to-rgb() at compile time, so light theme is a second build rather than CSS variables; tokens are !default so the light file sets them first.
